Class Base

java.lang.Object
dev.blitical.jigsawDB.drivers.Driver
dev.blitical.jigsawDB.drivers.hierarchy.Base
Direct Known Subclasses:
MySQLikeDriver, PostgreSQLDriver, SQLiteDriver
public abstract class Base extends Driver
This is the Base class.
In a hierarchy, all drivers will extend this class.
This contains methods common to all drivers.
